name: ONE TAP PISTOLS [UPDATE]
desc:
✨ Welcome to ONE TAP PISTOLS! ✨
Jump into the ultimate fast-paced, high-stakes pistol arena where it only takes one clean shot to dominate. Grab your weapon, trust your aim, and prove you have the best reaction time on Roblox!

🔥 FEATURES:
🔫 Unlock & Equip: Earn coins to unlock new pistols, rare skins, and clean kill effects!
🏆 Climb the Ranks: Show off your killstreaks and claim your spot on the leaderboards.
⚡ Fast-Paced Action: Instant respawns and non-stop gunfights.

🎮 PLATFORM SUPPORT:
PC 💻 | Mobile 📱 | Tablet | Console 🎮 (Xbox & PlayStation)

👍 Enjoying the game? Leave a thumbs-up and join our group for exclusive rewards!
